svg.aria-label: UML class diagram of the crawler's parser: the parsePageVacancies half of CompanyCrawler. CrawlerRunnerService holds a map of CompanyCrawler beans and a CrawlingProgressService. DefaultCompanyCrawler realizes CompanyCrawler and implements parsePageVacancies as a final method over the abstract configurePageParser and the configureVacancyDetailsCrawler hook. It uses the crawler's PageParser, which turns a page into preview vacancies, and a VacancyDetailsCrawler, NoCallVacancyDetailsCrawler by default, which fetches a vacancy's own page with a PageScraper and returns the VacancyDTO that replaces the preview one. The models package holds ScrapeSettings, VacancyDTO and PageScraperResponse. VacancyPageParseException, VacancyDetailsScrapeException and VacancyDetailsParseException extend RuntimeException.
